rule: every row names a runnable checker or test and a planted mutant; a row without a passing checker cannot be PROVED; no novelty claim

obligations.statement: Evidence dependence in science: corroboration counts distinct sources; replicates from one dependent source count once; a hypothesis's warrant is ⊕ over distinct-source supports and dies under a live counter-observation.

A causal conclusion requires registered identification assumptions (randomised intervention or a registered back-door set); graph structure or correlation alone never licenses it; naive regression on confounded worlds is biased while back-door and interventional estimators recover the oracle effect; adjusting on a collider is flagged non-identified.

Experiment selection by expected elimination of live hypotheses minus cost and risk (batch-3 C1 applied to hypotheses) prefers the discriminating low-risk test, stops when nothing is worth its cost or one hypothesis remains, and never runs an experiment to confirm a preferred hypothesis (hostile).
obligations.parent: value of information / Bayesian experimental design (Lindley 1956) — candidate

obligations.statement: Analysis lifecycle is pre-registered per task (estimand and test fixed before the outcome); exact permutation tests; the number of analyses tried is reported; the p-hacking hostile searches subsets until significance and is counted separately.

Proof-kernel boundary: PASS(certificate) | FAIL | CANNOT_CHECK from a registered kernel; a warranted proof object exists only on PASS; the kernel warrant and the formalisation-correspondence warrant are separate records; a FAIL is evidence of falsity only from a complete kernel with a countermodel; Lean 4 is CANNOT_CHECK in this study.
obligations.limitation: propositional kernel only; no Lean toolchain

obligations.statement: Scientific retraction: a conclusion is a derived record (⊗ of its supporting observations), so retracting one observation kills exactly the conclusions that rested on it, unrelated conclusions stay, replacement support is a new record with lineage and the old stays dead; replay reproduces it.
obligations.mutant: (retracted evidence remaining in a derived conclusion — excluded by derived_from)

obligations.statement: Cross-field transfer maps M9 work roles to science roles through TransferMap.v1: full mapping TRANSFER with ⊗ warrant; a missing science binding ADAPTER_REQUIRED; a work verifier bound as statistical validation REFUSE_TRANSFER.

Communication gate: the strongest licensed marker is fixed by the epistemic state (proves / causes / suggests / is consistent with / cannot determine); an overclaim is downgraded, a sentence without a marker is refused, and fluent wording never hides CANNOT_CHECK.
External scientific benchmarks (SciCode-Verified, ResearchGym, LifeSciBench full, miniF2F/Lean 4) and any frontier target: CANNOT_CHECK in this study; no discovery claim.
